reason: All three Discovery pipelines resolved their due P0 coverage. Twenty-two material same-day signals were normalized without topic selection: eight AI-platform signals and fourteen GitHub-engineering signals; no same-day published-research object met the retention threshold.
reason_zh: 三条 Discovery 管线均完成 P0 到期来源覆盖。本日规范化保留 22 个实质性同日信号，未执行选题：AI 平台 8 个、GitHub 工程 14 个；论文与研究成果管线没有发现达到保留阈值的同日研究对象。

pipelines.label: AI Platform Change Intelligence
pipelines.label_zh: AI 平台变更情报发现
pipelines.reason: All 45 due public P0 platform channels were checked. Claude Code v2.1.251, published during the Asia/Shanghai run date, supplied eight retained platform mechanisms; no other checked platform channel produced an additional material same-day mechanism after deduplication.
pipelines.reason_zh: 45 个到期 P0 公共平台通道全部完成检查。Asia/Shanghai 运行日内发布的 Claude Code v2.1.251 提供了 8 个保留的平台机制；其余已检查平台通道经去重后没有形成额外实质性同日机制。

Fourteen retained run-date mechanisms came from OpenAI Codex, Google ADK, Gemini CLI and the MCP TypeScript SDK; Claude Code was deduplicated into the AI-platform release object, while OpenAI Agents SDK, GitHub Copilot CLI, MCP Python SDK and A2A had no retained run-date change.
pipelines.reason_zh: 9 个 P0 Daily 仓库均从前一日检查点完成增量检查。14 个保留的运行日机制来自 OpenAI Codex、Google ADK、Gemini CLI 与 MCP TypeScript SDK；Claude Code 变化已去重归入 AI Platform Release 对象，OpenAI Agents SDK、GitHub Copilot CLI、MCP Python SDK 与 A2A 没有保留的运行日变化。

pipelines.reason_zh: 9 个 P0 研究来源全部收口：8 个已检查，1 个明确记录抓取失败；未发现发表于运行日且达到保留阈值的实质研究对象。

columns.reason: Discovery recorded seven primary Digital Employee signals; Queue owns scoring and selection.
columns.reason_zh: Discovery 记录了 7 个以数字员工为主栏目的信号；评分与选题由 Queue 独立负责。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.reason: Discovery recorded eleven primary Industry Architecture signals; Queue owns scoring and selection.
columns.reason_zh: Discovery 记录了 11 个以行业架构为主栏目的信号；评分与选题由 Queue 独立负责。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.reason: Discovery recorded four primary Open-source Engineering signals; Queue owns scoring and selection.
columns.reason_zh: Discovery 记录了 4 个以开源工程为主栏目的信号；评分与选题由 Queue 独立负责。

signals.title: Claude Code adds governed model-switch hooks and resume staleness context
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 新增受治理的模型切换 Hook 与恢复陈旧度上下文
signals.summary: Model-switch hooks can block, confirm or annotate transitions, while resume hooks expose session staleness and re-cache cost as explicit control facts.
signals.summary_zh: 模型切换 Hook 可阻止、确认或标注转换；恢复 Hook 同时暴露会话陈旧度与重新缓存成本，使其成为显式控制事实。

signals.title: Claude Code closes symlink-swap TOCTOU gaps in file permissions
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 封堵文件权限检查后的 Symlink Swap TOCTOU 缺口
signals.summary: Read, Write and Edit no longer follow a symlink swapped after permission validation, preventing post-check path mutation from escaping the approved file boundary.
signals.summary_zh: Read、Write、Edit 不再跟随权限校验后被替换的符号链接，避免通过校验后的路径变更逃逸已批准文件边界。

signals.title: Claude Code rejects plugin command paths outside the plugin directory
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 拒绝逃逸插件目录的插件命令路径
signals.summary: Marketplace plugin commands are rejected when their path resolves outside the plugin directory, enforcing a concrete path boundary.
signals.summary_zh: Marketplace 插件命令如果路径解析到插件目录之外会被拒绝，从而强制实施明确路径边界。

signals.title: Claude Code prevents lower-scope tracing settings from bypassing managed telemetry policy
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 阻止低权限追踪设置绕过托管遥测策略
signals.summary: Project tracing and raw-body logging can no longer bypass higher-authority managed telemetry settings or a host-pinned OTLP collector.
signals.summary_zh: 项目级追踪与原始 Body Logging 不再能绕过更高权限的托管遥测设置或宿主固定的 OTLP Collector。

signals.title: Claude Code delivers teammate final answers as explicit team-lead completion messages
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 将队友最终答复作为显式完成消息送达 Team Lead
signals.summary: A teammate final answer now reaches the team lead instead of degrading to a content-free availability notice, separating worker availability from work completion.
signals.summary_zh: 队友最终答复现在会送达 Team Lead，不再退化成无内容的可用通知，从而区分 Worker 可用与工作完成。

signals.title: Claude Code bounds lost MCP handshake acknowledgments to one failed server
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 将丢失的 MCP Handshake ACK 限定为单 Server 有界失败
signals.summary: Lost SDK MCP handshake acknowledgments now time out after 70 seconds and fail only that server instead of hanging the whole session indefinitely.
signals.summary_zh: SDK MCP Handshake ACK 丢失时现在会在 70 秒后超时，并且只失败该 Server，不再让整个 Session 无限挂起。

signals.title: Claude Code routes Chrome browser actions through one permission boundary
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 将 Chrome 浏览器动作统一纳入同一权限边界
signals.summary: Chrome browser actions now always pass through Claude Code permission checks, removing a separate extension-local authorization path.
signals.summary_zh: Chrome 浏览器动作现在始终经过 Claude Code 权限检查，移除了独立的扩展本地授权路径。

signals.title: Claude Code approval-gates managed settings that weaken sandbox or inject sensitive headers
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 对削弱 Sandbox 或注入敏感 Header 的托管设置强制审批
signals.summary: Managed settings that weaken sandbox isolation, inject credentials or set sensitive routing headers now require explicit approval before taking effect.
signals.summary_zh: 削弱 Sandbox 隔离、注入凭据或设置敏感路由 Header 的托管设置现在必须经过显式审批后才能生效。

signals.title: Codex answers bounded terminal queries so PTY subprocesses cannot hang waiting for the TTY
signals.title_zh: Codex 对 Terminal Query 提供有界响应，避免 PTY 子进程等待终端而挂死
signals.summary: Codex intercepts common PTY terminal queries and writes bounded responses back to subprocess input, including queries split across chunks.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 拦截常见 PTY Terminal Query，并向子进程输入写回有界响应，也能处理跨 Chunk 的查询。

signals.title: Codex runs cleanup hooks for interrupted turns with turn-local context
signals.title_zh: Codex 在 Turn 被中断时运行 Cleanup Hook，并绑定本 Turn 上下文
signals.summary: Executor cleanup hooks now observe Interrupt as well as Stop and use the interrupted turn's own last-step discovery and metadata instead of stale prior-turn context.
signals.summary_zh: Executor Cleanup Hook 现在同时观察 Interrupt 与 Stop，并使用被中断 Turn 自己的最后 Step Discovery 与元数据，而不是陈旧的前一 Turn 上下文。

signals.title: Codex retains the selected StepContext across completion and interruption
signals.title_zh: Codex 在完成与中断后保留已选择的 StepContext
signals.summary: Active turns keep the most recently selected StepContext through completion or interruption while speculative fallback captures cannot overwrite it unless selected.
signals.summary_zh: Active Turn 在完成或中断后保留最近真正选中的 StepContext；推测性 Fallback Capture 除非被选用，否则不能覆盖它。

signals.title: Codex reconstructs nested-agent context from surviving full baselines
signals.title_zh: Codex 从保留的完整 Baseline 重建嵌套 Agent 上下文
signals.summary: A surviving full world-state snapshot can restore nested-agent settings and reference context, while partial or superseded snapshots are rejected.
signals.summary_zh: 保留的完整 World-state Snapshot 可恢复嵌套 Agent 的设置与 Reference Context，而 Partial 或已被替代的 Snapshot 会被拒绝。

signals.title: Codex builds a shared Guardian transcript with role and tool provenance
signals.title_zh: Codex 构建共享 Guardian Transcript，并保留角色与 Tool Provenance
signals.summary: Guardian review now uses a reusable transcript collector that preserves conversation order and role/tool attribution across synchronous and asynchronous review paths.
signals.summary_zh: Guardian Review 现在使用共享 Transcript Collector，在同步与异步 Review 路径之间保留对话顺序以及 Role/Tool Attribution。

signals.title: Codex persists the strictest per-tool MCP output budget across resume
signals.title_zh: Codex 将最严格的单 Tool MCP 输出预算持久贯穿 Resume
signals.summary: Overlapping MCP output policies resolve to the strictest per-tool token budget and persist the effective limit into history for hooks and resumed sessions.
signals.summary_zh: 重叠的 MCP 输出策略采用最严格的单 Tool Token Budget，并把有效限制写入历史，供 Hook 与 Resume Session 一致使用。

signals.title: Codex restricts cloud-task credentials to trusted origins with redirects disabled
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Cloud-task 凭据限制在可信 Origin，并禁用重定向
signals.summary: Saved ChatGPT credentials are loaded only for validated HTTPS origins on port 443 with redirects disabled and ambiguous URL components rejected.
signals.summary_zh: 已保存 ChatGPT 凭据只会为通过验证的 443 HTTPS Origin 加载，同时禁用 Redirect，并拒绝含糊 URL 组件。

signals.title: Codex keeps managed one-shot execution without retained-process authority
signals.title_zh: Codex 在托管模式保留 One-shot Exec，但不暴露 Retained-process 权限
signals.summary: When managed policy disables resumable execution, exec_command remains completion-only with TTY/session/write-stdin removed and bounded timeout/cancellation termination.
signals.summary_zh: 托管策略禁用可恢复执行时，exec_command 只保留一次性完成模式，移除 TTY/Session/write-stdin，并由有界 Timeout/Cancel 负责终止。

signals.title: Codex gives Guardian classifications stable retry identity and explicit lineage
signals.title_zh: Codex 为 Guardian Classification 提供稳定重试身份与显式 Lineage
signals.summary: Guardian classifications now keep a UUIDv7 turn identity across retries, link known parent/root turns, and omit ambiguous root lineage instead of inventing it.
signals.summary_zh: Guardian Classification 现在跨重试保持 UUIDv7 Turn Identity，关联已知 Parent/Root Turn，并在 Root Lineage 不明确时省略而不是臆造。

signals.title: Google ADK terminates the full local process tree on command timeout
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在本地命令超时时终止完整 Process Tree
signals.summary: ADK command timeout handling now terminates the entire local process tree so child processes cannot outlive the bounded command lifecycle.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 命令超时处理现在会终止整个本地 Process Tree，避免子进程越过有界命令生命周期继续存活。

signals.title: Google ADK resolves HITL interrupts by exact branch run identity
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 以精确 Branch Run Identity 解析 HITL Interrupt
signals.summary: Human-in-the-loop interrupt resolution now matches exact branch run IDs, tightening approval and resume binding to the intended branch execution.
signals.summary_zh: Human-in-the-loop Interrupt 解析现在精确匹配 Branch Run ID，把审批与 Resume 更严格地绑定到预期分支执行。

signals.title: Google ADK stops advertising run_skill_script when no executor exists
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在无 Executor 时不再宣告 run_skill_script 能力
signals.summary: SkillToolset withholds run_skill_script and its prompt guidance unless an actual code executor is available, preventing false capability promises.
signals.summary_zh: 除非实际存在 Code Executor，SkillToolset 不再注册 run_skill_script 或提供其 Prompt 指导，避免虚假能力承诺。

signals.title: Gemini CLI makes workspace trust fail closed and filters MCP in restricted mode
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 将 Workspace Trust 改为 Fail-closed，并在 Restricted Mode 过滤 MCP
signals.summary: Gemini CLI now enforces fail-closed workspace trust and filters MCP servers in restricted mode, coupling admission to the effective tool surface.
signals.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 现在对 Workspace Trust 执行 Fail-closed，并在 Restricted Mode 过滤 MCP Server，把准入与实际工具面绑定。

signals.title: MCP TypeScript SDK propagates taskId into Mcp-Name for task requests
signals.title_zh: MCP TypeScript SDK 将 taskId 传播到 Task Request 的 Mcp-Name
signals.summary: MCP task requests now mirror params.taskId into Mcp-Name, strengthening task identity propagation across the protocol request boundary.
signals.summary_zh: MCP Task Request 现在把 params.taskId 镜像到 Mcp-Name，加强任务身份在协议请求边界上的传播。
